name: Your product
description: Your product is a web app that helps a team do one job well. This page says what it is, who it is for, and what it does.

definition.what: Your product is a web app that helps a team do one job well.
definition.who: It is for teams that do this job every week and want one place to do it.
definition.does: It keeps the work in one place, shows what is left to do, and records what changed.

mainQuestion: Is Your product right for my team?
itDependsAnswer: It depends on how often your team does this job and where the work lives today. If the job comes up every week and the work is spread across email and spreadsheets, Your product saves time because it keeps everything in one place. If the job comes up a few times a year, a shared document may be enough.

features.title: One place for the work
features.body: Every item, file and decision lives in one place that the whole team can see.

features.title: Clear next steps
features.body: Each person sees what is left to do and who is waiting on them.

features.title: A record of changes
features.body: Every change is saved with who made it and when.
